api_key.description: Snyk API token. Works with all API endpoints. Can also be set via SNYK_API_KEY. Mutually exclusive with client_id/client_secret.

client_id.description: OAuth 2.0 client ID for the Snyk service account. Can also be set via SNYK_CLIENT_ID. Must be paired with client_secret. Note: the v1 import endpoint does not support OAuth; use api_key if you need imports.

client_secret.description: OAuth 2.0 client secret for the Snyk service account. Can also be set via SNYK_CLIENT_SECRET.

org_id.description: Snyk organization ID. Can also be set via SNYK_ORG_ID.

block.description: Manages resources in Snyk.io via the Snyk API.

branch.description: Branch to monitor. Defaults to the repository's default branch when left empty.

project_ids.description: List of Snyk project IDs created for this repository (one per detected manifest file).

block.description: Imports a source-code repository into Snyk and keeps it monitored. Destroying this resource removes all Snyk projects that were created for the repository.
